chunk.content: Before it was formally described, the Queensland school mackerel (Scomberomorus queenslandicus) was confused with the spotted Spanish mackerel S. guttatus.
chunk.source_quote: Prior to its description, this species was confused with S. guttatus.

source.title: FAO Species Catalogue Vol. 2 Scombrids of the World (FAO Fisheries Synopsis No. 125)
